D.t: Callie Barr trails by 13.6 and wins 2% of simulations. Closing it takes about 26,302 voters switching sides, or 52,605 more net votes from new turnout.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between R +21.8 and R +5.4. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$769K cash against $563K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.

R.t: Jack Bergman leads by 13.6 in the forecast and wins 98% of simulations. The cushion is about 52,605 votes; a one point swing is about 1,934 voters changing sides.

$563K cash against $769K. Outspent: lean on earned media, digital, field and the outside groups, and pick the two or three media markets that decide it.
